natural_language: A regression has N observations and P predictors. The design matrix is observed, as is the response vector. The coefficient vector and a positive noise scale are unknown. The coefficients are drawn from a normal law about a fixed prior location vector with a fixed positive prior scale; the noise scale is drawn from a half normal with that same prior scale. The response is drawn from a normal law whose centre is the design matrix applied to the coefficients and whose spread is the noise scale. List exactly the symbols the response is conditioned on.
distractors: Omitting the design matrix from the conditioning set because it is 'just data'. Observed status and conditioning status are different facts.
Including the prior location vector because it appears in the model. The response depends on it only through the coefficients.
Transposing the design matrix so that the inner dimensions no longer agree; the prose fixes N as rows and P as columns.
